adaptation: logical_not_kernel scalar lambda specialized to FP32 inputs and FP32 0/1 output. TensorIterator maps to a contiguous C loop. C++ explicit casts map to exact C conversions; the C++ lambda is retained for independent checks. cuDNN graph opcodes are mechanically selected from the imported reference, with vendor semantics validated separately; this is not cuDNN implementation source.

specs.name: aten_logical_not_f32
assumptions: positive n <= INT_MAX; contiguous FP32 arrays
output disjoint from inputs; FP32 output represents boolean 0/1
floating exceptions and errno not observed
